cases.exposure_context_quote: admitted to our hospital after consuming approximately 5 ml of 24% paraquat dichloride six hours prior to being discovered by a relative
cases.agent_quote: consuming approximately 5 ml of 24% paraquat dichloride
cases.circumstance: ingestion discovered six hours later by a relative; no significant family, personal, or psychiatric history (intent not explicitly stated)

symptoms.finding: 2–3 episodes of vomiting at home before admission
symptoms.quote: Before admission, the patient reported experiencing 2 to 3 episodes of vomiting at home.

symptoms.finding: hematemesis (three episodes) and brief jerky body movements with unconsciousness on day 5
symptoms.quote: On the fifth day, the patient had three episodes of hematemesis and a sudden episode of brief jerky body movements followed by unconsciousness.

symptoms.finding: inability to maintain oxygen saturation on room air on day 6; agitation and disorientation
symptoms.quote: By the sixth day, the patient was unable to maintain oxygen saturation on room air and was put on BPAP with 60% O2
On the seventh day, the patient went into cardiogenic shock and required inotropic support.

cases.time_to_care: initially taken to a local hospital; discovered six hours after ingestion

labs.name: urea
labs.quote: initial laboratory results showed elevated urea (26mg/dL)

labs.name: creatinine
labs.quote: Creatinine levels rose from 0.97 to 2.45, 3.03, 3.29, 4.04, 4.41, 3.15 and 4.62mg/dL

labs.name: potassium
labs.quote: low potassium at 3.2 mEq/L (reference range: 3.5-5.1 mEq/L)

labs.name: arterial blood gas
labs.value: pH 7.4, pCO2 32.5, HCO3 22.8 initially; metabolic acidosis on day 5
labs.quote: Arterial blood gas analysis (ABGA) indicated a pH of 7.4, pCO2 of 32.5, and HCO3 of 22.8.

labs.name: platelet count
labs.value: 2.29 lacs/mm3 initially, decreased to 1,36,000/mm3 on day 5
labs.quote: Blood tests on this day indicated a decreased platelet count (1,36,000/mm3)

treatment.name: gastric lavage and IV fluids at local hospital
treatment.quote: He was initially taken to a local hospital where he received gastric lavage and intravenous fluids before he was referred to our facility

treatment.name: N-acetyl cysteine IV regimen (8 g then 3 g then 6 g in 5% dextrose)
treatment.quote: He was treated with intravenous N-Acetyl cysteine 8 gm in 200 ml 5% dextrose over 1 hour, followed by 3 gm in 500 ml 5% dextrose over 4 hours, followed by 6 gm in 1000 ml 5% dextrose over 16 hours

treatment.name: methylprednisolone 500 mg IV over 30 minutes for 3 days
treatment.quote: Intravenous Methylprednisolone 500 mg in 250 ml Normal saline over 30 minutes for 3 days

treatment.name: potassium chloride injections; Vitamin K, tranexamic acid, diazepam, phenytoin on day 5; BPAP with 60% O2; haemodialysis; invasive mechanical ventilation; inotropic support
treatment.quote: He underwent haemodialysis for acute kidney injury ... necessitating invasive mechanical ventilation for 24 hours ... went into cardiogenic shock and required inotropic support.

cases.outcome: died on the seventh day of admission
cases.outcome_quote: Despite all efforts, his condition continued to deteriorate, and he succumbed to death on the seventh day of admission.
cases.notes: Early hemoperfusion not possible due to unavailability of the adsorbent; severe metabolic acidosis and multi-organ dysfunction developed.
